import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)
import Runner (snapshot)

pub fn step_status(status : StepStatus) : String =
  match status of
    Pending => "pending"
    Running => "running"
    Succeeded => "succeeded"
    Failed => "failed"
    Blocked => "blocked"
    Cancelled => "cancelled"

pub fn run_status(status : RunStatus) : String =
  match status of
    Failing => "failing"
    Active => "active"
    Completed => "succeeded"
    RunFailed => "failed"
    Cancelling => "cancelling"
    RunCancelled => "cancelled"

fn step_json(step : StepState) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(step.id)), ("status", JStr(step_status(step.status))),
    ("attempts", JInt(step.attempts)), ("ready_at", JInt(step.ready_at))])

fn run_json(run : RunState) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(run.id)), ("status", JStr(run_status(run.status))),
    ("cancel_requested", JBool(run.cancel_requested)), ("steps", JArr(map(step_json, run.steps)))])

fn snapshot_fields(state : Snapshot) : List((String, Json)) =
  [("now", JInt(state.now)), ("up", JBool(state.up)), ("runs", JArr(map(run_json, state.runs)))]

fn snapshot_json(state : Snapshot) : Json = JObj(snapshot_fields(state))

pub fn key_json(key : ActionKey) : Json = JArr([JStr(key.run_id), JStr(key.step_id)])

fn call_json(call : ServiceCall) : Json =
  JObj([("kind", JStr(call.kind)), ("key", key_json(call.key)),
    ("attempt", JInt(call.attempt)), ("outcome", JStr(call.outcome))])

pub fn effect_json(entry : Effect) : Json =
  JObj([("key", key_json(entry.key)), ("amount", JInt(entry.amount))])

pub fn result_json(sim : Simulator) : Json =
  let final_fields = append(snapshot_fields(snapshot(sim)),
    [("calls", JArr(map(call_json, sim.service.calls))), ("effects", JArr(map(effect_json, sim.service.effects)))])
  JObj([("observations", JArr(map(snapshot_json, sim.observations))), ("final", JObj(final_fields))])

pub fn response_json(result : Result(Simulator, String)) : Json =
  match result of
    Ok(sim) => JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", result_json(sim))])
    Err(code) => JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)

fn ensure(valid : Bool, code : String) : Result(Unit, String) =
  if valid then Ok(()) else Err(code)

fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

fn fields(value : Json, required : List(String), optional : List(String)) : Result(List((String, Json)), String) =
  match value of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      let keys = map(\(pair) -> fst(pair), pairs)
      let _ = ensure(unique(keys) && all(\(key) -> elem(key, keys), required)
          && all(\(key) -> elem(key, append(required, optional)), keys), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(pairs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn get_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => JNull

fn optional_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String, default : Json) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => default

fn integer(value : Json, low : Int, high : Int) : Result(Int, String) =
  match value of
    JInt(n) =>
      let _ = ensure(n >= low && n <= high, "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(n)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn valid_id_bytes(s : String, i : Int) : Bool =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then true
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    ((c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)
      || (c >= 48 && c <= 57) || c == 95 || c == 45) && valid_id_bytes(s, i + 1)

fn identifier(value : Json) : Result(String, String) =
  match value of
    JStr(s) =>
      let _ = ensure(byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 64 && valid_id_bytes(s, 0), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(s)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn array(value : Json) : Result(List(Json), String) =
  match value of
    JArr(xs) => Ok(xs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_ids(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(String), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let name = identifier(x)?
      let names = parse_ids(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(name, names))

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

fn parse_steps(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(StepDefinition), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let step = parse_step(x)?
      let steps = parse_steps(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(step, steps))

fn parse_checkpoint(obj : List((String, Json))) : Result(Option(Checkpoint), String) =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "crash_at", obj) of
    None => Ok(None)
    Some(pair) =>
      match snd(pair) of
        JStr(name) =>
          if name == "after_begin" then Ok(Some(AfterBegin))
          elif name == "after_call" then Ok(Some(AfterCall))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json), leased : Bool) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = (if leased then parse_leased_command(x) else parse_command(x))?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest, leased)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

-- Kahn's algorithm permits forward references while detecting self and multi-step cycles.
fn acyclic(remaining : List(StepDefinition), visited : List(String)) : Bool =
  if is_nil(remaining) then true
  else
    let ready = filter(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, visited), step.needs), remaining)
    if is_nil(ready) then false
    else
      let seen = append(visited, map(\(step) -> step.id, ready))
      acyclic(filter(\(step) -> not(elem(step.id, seen)), remaining), seen)

fn validate_graph(steps : List(StepDefinition)) : Result(Unit, String) =
  let ids = map(\(step) -> step.id, steps)
  let _ = ensure(unique(ids), "DUPLICATE_STEP")?
  let _ = ensure(all(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, ids), step.needs), steps), "UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY")?
  ensure(acyclic(steps, []), "DEPENDENCY_CYCLE")

pub fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let leased = match raw of
    JObj(pairs) => any(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "workers", pairs)
    _ => false
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], if leased then ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "workers", "lease_duration"] else ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let worker_result =
    if leased then
      let values = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
      parse_ids(values)
    else Ok([])
  let workers = worker_result?
  let _ = ensure(not(leased) || (not(is_nil(workers)) && unique(workers)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let duration = (if leased then integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000) else Ok(5))?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let _ = ensure(not(leased) || length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands, leased)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, workers = workers, lease_duration = duration })

pub fn parse_request(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["protocol_version", "task", "input"], [])?
  let _ = integer(get_field(obj, "protocol_version"), 1, 1)?
  let valid_task = match get_field(obj, "task") of
    JStr(name) => name == "workflow-recovery"
    _ => false
  let _ = ensure(valid_task, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  parse_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))

fn parse_leased_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if elem(op, ["start", "cancel", "advance", "observe"]) then parse_command(raw)
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(Deliver(ticket))
          elif elem(op, ["claim", "crash", "restart", "renew", "call"]) then
            let needs_ticket = op == "renew" || op == "call"
            let obj = fields(raw, if needs_ticket then ["op", "worker", "ticket"] else ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = (if needs_ticket then integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit()) else Ok(0))?
            Ok(WorkerCommand(op, worker, ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

type Command
  = Start(String)

  | Advance(Int)

fn live(now : Int, step : StepState) : Bool =
  match step.lease of
    Some(l) => now < l.expires
    None => false

defs.name: current
defs.source:
fn current(s : State, t : Ticket, step : StepState) : Bool =
  match step.lease of
    Some(l) => l.ticket == t.id && l.worker == t.worker && s.now < l.expires && step.status == Running
    None => false

fn select_runs(s : State, w : Workflow, runs : List(RunState), recovery : Bool) : Option((RunState, StepState)) =
  match runs of
    Nil => None
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      match select_steps(s, w, r, r.steps, recovery) of
        Some(a) => Some(a)
        None => select_runs(s, w, rest, recovery)

fn owned_live(step : StepState, worker : String, now : Int) : Bool =
  match step.lease of
    Some(l) => l.worker == worker && now < l.expires
    None => false

defs.name: ticket_step
defs.source:
fn ticket_step(s : State, t : Ticket) : Result((RunState, StepState), String) =
  match find(\(r) -> r.id == t.run_id, s.runs) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_RUN")
    Some(r) =>
      match find(\(step) -> step.id == t.step_id, r.steps) of
        None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
        Some(step) => Ok((r, step))

      commands(next, w, rest)

fn select_run(now : Int, inflight : Bool, runs : List(RunState), definitions : List(StepDefinition)) : Option(Action) =
  match runs of
    Nil => None
    Cons(run, rest) =>
      match select_step(now, inflight, run, run.steps, definitions) of
        Some(action) => Some(action)
        None => select_run(now, inflight, rest, definitions)

defs.name: select_action
defs.source:
fn select_action(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow) : Option(Action) =
  -- Resume the oldest in-flight attempt before scanning ready pending work.
  match select_run(sim.now, true, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
    Some(action) => Some(action)
    None => select_run(sim.now, false, sim.runs, workflow.steps)

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

defs.name: parse_steps
defs.source:
fn parse_steps(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(StepDefinition), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let step = parse_step(x)?
      let steps = parse_steps(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(step, steps))

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: parse_commands
defs.source:
fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json), leased : Bool) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = (if leased then parse_leased_command(x) else parse_command(x))?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest, leased)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let leased = match raw of
    JObj(pairs) => any(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "workers", pairs)
    _ => false
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], if leased then ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "workers", "lease_duration"] else ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let worker_result =
    if leased then
      let values = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
      parse_ids(values)
    else Ok([])
  let workers = worker_result?
  let _ = ensure(not(leased) || (not(is_nil(workers)) && unique(workers)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let duration = (if leased then integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000) else Ok(5))?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let _ = ensure(not(leased) || length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands, leased)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, workers = workers, lease_duration = duration })

defs.source:
fn parse_request(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["protocol_version", "task", "input"], [])?
  let _ = integer(get_field(obj, "protocol_version"), 1, 1)?
  let valid_task = match get_field(obj, "task") of
    JStr(name) => name == "workflow-recovery"
    _ => false
  let _ = ensure(valid_task, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  parse_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))

defs.name: parse_leased_command
defs.source:
fn parse_leased_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if elem(op, ["start", "cancel", "advance", "observe"]) then parse_command(raw)
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(Deliver(ticket))
          elif elem(op, ["claim", "crash", "restart", "renew", "call"]) then
            let needs_ticket = op == "renew" || op == "call"
            let obj = fields(raw, if needs_ticket then ["op", "worker", "ticket"] else ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = (if needs_ticket then integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit()) else Ok(0))?
            Ok(WorkerCommand(op, worker, ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: handle_request
defs.source:
fn handle_request(line : String) : Result(Json, String) =
  let request = map_err(\(_) -> "INVALID_INPUT", decode_lossy(line))?
  let workflow = parse_request(request)?
  if is_nil(workflow.workers) then
    let sim = simulate(workflow)?
    Ok(result_json(sim))
  else Leased.simulate(workflow)

defs.name: main
defs.source:
fn main() =
  let response = match handle_request(read_line()) of
    Ok(result) => JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", result)])
    Err(code) => JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])
  println(encode(response))
